title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: If you have anything behind-the-scenes about the Galarraga game, let me know. I am working on a big project about it. Off-record, but you might know things that I can ask people

It was a very normal day with not much backstory.  After the game I was taken with how calm and professional Andres was about what happened.  I would have been raging and he was no joke calm and understanding about Joyce’s call.  Everyone else was losing their mind for him.  And I ended up feeling really sorry for Joyce after.  That dude came in our clubhouse post game crying and apologizing.  He showed serious remorse and you couldn’t help but feel bad for them both.  It was a fucked up ending that involved 2 men on either side of the call that both acted like fucking professionals in the end.
Yep... so he actually came into the clubhouse?
I ask because I wonder how many times he’s ever been in another team’s clubhouse, you know

Yeah once most the players had left.   Wanted to talk to Leyland and Andres to apologize and apologize for the call.  I do know this from talking with Kevin Rand...MLB gave  him the option to not call the next days game.  He was set to behind the plate and everyone knew he was going to be booed and harassed by the fans.  Joyce said it was his responsibility to be at that game and owned up to his mistake which led to the moment at home plate between him and Andres.
